text:
anya: quick design review  chart header polish idea: collapse long y-axis label to one line, show compact unit pill (e.g., 'Units: USD') and move smoothing toggle next to legend. mock: https://figma.com/file/yyy/compact-header
lucas: looks cleaner. question: when legend has long series names, does the pill overlap? how does it behave on narrow panels?
anya: prototype uses truncation + tooltip for legend items, pill is right-aligned in header and shrinks on narrow widths to icon+tooltip
naiya: accessibility nits: pill needs aria-label ("Units: US dollars") and keyboard focus. also don't rely on color for outlier markers. add pattern or icon so screenreaders & color-blind users get cues.
lucas: agree re outliers. prefer marker+tooltip rather than auto-capping the axis — preserves trend context. microcopy idea: "Outlier: 12.3M — enable 'cap max' to compress view."
anya: plan: 1) add aria-label & focusable pill, 2) truncation + tooltip for legend, 3) place smoothing toggle in toolbar but reorder DOM so legend tabbable first, 4) default outlier marker with optional cap mode, 5) add QA a11y checklist.
designbot: opened issue #3042 assigned to @anya for prototype updates.
lucas: will review prototype once posted. naiya: i'll draft acceptance criteria for keyboard/VO testing.
